correctness.rationale: All pair-state transitions are explicitly computed, two branch potentials checked for exact cost drops and strict inequalities. Positive costs make the optimal policy unique for every size. The descending potential terminates by finiteness, proving attainment and universal optimality; disjoint intervals by circular gap prove the precise spectrum. Independently implemented forward BFS and reverse weighted Dijkstra agree on all tested pairs; the infinite statement is proved symbolically, not inferred from experiments.
